chain_evaluate_config_scopes: chain evaluate multiple ConfigScope decorated functions to combine their config keys into a final config dictionary
ConfigScope_decorator: create a ConfigScope decorated function that defines configuration variables accessible to downstream scopes
ConfigDict_wrapper: create a ConfigDict wrapper from a ConfigScope result to use in chained config scope evaluation
test_chained_config_scopes_with_fixed: test chained config scopes with fixed parameters that prevent modification of locked config values
test_chained_config_scopes_with_preset: test chained config scopes with preset parameters that provide initial values included in the final config
